utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Kira, I heard the repair drive’s picking up steam—folks are dropping by tools and spare parts all afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Is that definitely happening today, or is it still just talk? I’d want to hear it confirmed before I carry anything over.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: From what I’ve heard, it’s definitely on today—Mara said people were already setting things out by noon. If you’ve got anything useful, I’d bring it over this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I heard there’s a repair drive coming up soon, and I’ve been telling folks so more neighbors can join in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive—good you’ve been spreading the word, because I definitely would’ve forgotten otherwise. Do you know what day it is yet?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Not yet, but I’m keeping an ear out and I’ll tell everyone—including you—as soon as I hear the day.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help Saturday morning—what tools do we still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Saturday morning helps a lot. I think we still need a couple of ladders, a power drill, and some extra work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can bring a power drill and one ladder Saturday morning—want me to ask around for extra gloves too?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help quietly behind the scenes—what repairs still need doing?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We still need shingles for the roof and two working drills, and I’m short on gloves too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can ask around for a couple of drills and some spare gloves. If nobody has shingles, I can chip in a bit to help get them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to work around school pickup and drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s really helpful, Faye — we can definitely work around pickup and drop-off. If you want, I can plug you into a shift that fits between those times.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, that’d be great — anything mid-morning to early afternoon usually works best for me.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Oren — what’s the plan for the repair drive, and what time are we starting?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Morning, Eli — I’m a bit fuzzy on the details, but I think we said we’d start around 9 and gather by the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, let’s keep it simple then — I’ll be at the community shed a little before 9, and we can sort the list before we begin.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Pia, I’m telling everyone about the repair drive—want to help me spread the word and come by?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help spread the word, but what time is it and where should people park if a lot of folks show up?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Pia—that helps a ton. It’s at 10 on Saturday at the community lot by the tool shed, and if it gets crowded, folks can park along Maple and walk over.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard bits and pieces—do you know when the repair drive’s supposed to start?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes—kickoff’s this Saturday at 9 in the community lot, and we’ll get folks checked in as they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh good, thanks—I’d only heard rumors. Do you know if they still need people to bring tools, or is that already covered?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before we start the repair drive, can you remind me which houses already asked for help and what tools we’ve actually got on hand?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I don’t have the list in front of me yet, but I know we’ve heard from a few houses on Maple and one on Cedar. On hand, we’ve definitely got basic hand tools, a ladder, and the drill set.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps—before we make a plan, can you check which Maple houses it was and whether the drill batteries are charged?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little with the repair drive, just not for very long today.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll probably show up a bit late, but I can still pitch in once I get there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s alright. I’ll get started and do what I can until you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my drill and a couple of spare screwdrivers for the repair drive if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That helps. Can you also bring a tape measure, or should I ask someone else?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I’ve got a tape measure too, so I’ll bring that along with the drill and screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the repair drive route noted—where are we starting, Bo?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Start at the community center lot, then head east from there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—the community center lot first, then east from there. I’ve marked that as the starting point for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my drill and a couple of sawhorses for the repair drive if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d help a lot, Gus. I can spread the word to a couple of folks who might bring extra clamps too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, clamps always come in handy. I’ll load up the drill and sawhorses Saturday morning and head over early.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Kira, before we promise too much, do we know who’s bringing tools and how we’re getting the bulky stuff there?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Do we actually have that confirmed yet, or are we still assuming someone’s handling tools and transport?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s exactly what I’m worried about—we shouldn’t count on it until someone confirms tools and a way to haul the heavy items.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara, I’m glad you brought up the repair drive—if we coordinate a few different groups, I bet we can get a great turnout.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I think so too—if we loop in the PTA, the garden club, and the church volunteers, we’ll cover a lot of folks. I can start reaching out this week if you want.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be perfect, Mara—I’ll talk to the block association and a couple of the younger volunteers so we can keep the momentum going.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a decent count on tape, gloves, and spare screws—what do you still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, I’m coming in late—do we still need zip ties or a couple of extension cords?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yep, we could still use both—especially extension cords. If you can bring a couple cords and a pack of zip ties, I’ll mark them down on my list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Faye, I heard the repair drive’s shaping up nicely—folks are already setting aside tools and spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s great to hear—if we keep it after school pickup on Friday, I can help make sure families know when to drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, I’ll keep spreading the word and tell folks Friday after school pickup is the best time to bring things by.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure—what needs fixing first for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Let’s start with the porch rail on Maple and the two leaky faucets Mrs. Alvarez flagged, then we can move on to the loose gate by the community garden.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—porch rail first, then Mrs. Alvarez’s faucets, and we’ll hit the garden gate after.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to pitch in for the repair drive—what needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Start with the leaking roof on the community shed—if we stop that first, the rest can wait.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That makes sense—I’ll bring my ladder and some tarps so we can tackle the roof first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Nell, I’m getting folks together for the repair drive—want to come by and maybe bring anyone else who’d be into helping?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I can come by, and I’ll ask around too since I mostly hear things second-hand anyway. Just tell me when and where.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—Saturday at the community shed by noon, and please do spread the word to anyone who likes fixing things or just lending a hand.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the repair drive noted at the community center lot, and I want to keep the drop-off table near the east entrance so things stay easy to track.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds sensible to me; keeping the table by the east entrance should make the flow straightforward. If you like, I can be there a little early to help keep the drop-offs organized.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Eli—that helps. I’ll note you for an early arrival at the community center lot, east entrance, so we can keep the drop-offs in one clear spot.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How many homes still need repairs, and what do you need from me today?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to be precise before I answer—can you confirm the latest list, or should we count the homes on Maple and Cedar together right now? Today, I mainly need your help verifying which repair requests are still open.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Count Maple and Cedar together right now. How many open repair requests are we verifying today?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good to know—if the repair drive’s still moving, keep me posted while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Will do—I’ll send you an update if I hear anything, assuming I don’t misplace the note again.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks—just holler if there’s progress, and I’ll swing by once I’m back.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but we should pin down the timing, tools, and where people are supposed to park so it doesn’t turn into a mess.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that makes sense. I can ask a couple neighbors what time works and whether they can bring basic tools, then we can sort parking after that.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good—once you hear back, let’s pick one clear start time and make a simple list of what tools we still need so nobody shows up guessing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Quinn, I heard the repair drive’s shaping up nicely—folks have been dropping off tools all morning.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great news—I’m going to spread the word and invite a few more neighbors to bring what they can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’ll help a ton, Quinn—Mrs. Alvarez mentioned they could still use spare screws and extension cords if anyone’s got extras.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard bits and pieces—are folks still collecting tools and supplies for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, we still are—people have been dropping off tools, screws, and spare parts, and a few of us are organizing it this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Good to know—I’d only heard it second-hand. Do you know if they still need basic stuff like gloves or tape?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m spreading the word about the repair drive, Dane, so folks know when and where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Ah, I’m a bit late to it, but I can still help spread the word—when and where’s the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: It’s happening this Saturday at the community center parking lot from 10 to 2, and I’ve been telling everyone so nobody misses it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before we start the repair drive, can you confirm the date, location, and what supplies we already have?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I think it’s this Saturday at the community center, and we’ve already got basic tools and some spare parts. I’d double-check the exact time, though.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. Can you confirm the exact time and whether the community center means the main hall, and do we have enough gloves and extension cords?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Kira—I'm pulling together the repair drive list now, and I’d love your help making sure we haven’t missed any neighbors who need small fixes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sure, but can you show me the list you’ve got so far so I can double-check who’s actually been confirmed?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely—I’ve got Mrs. Alvarez, Theo in 3B, and the Johnsons confirmed so far; can you think of anyone else who’s definitely asked for help?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple, Sam—if we set a clear list and a start time, I’m in for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That works for me—I’ll put together a clear list tonight and we can start at 9 on Saturday if that suits you.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 9 on Saturday suits me fine. Bring the list, and we’ll go item by item so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to work around school pickup and drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What hours are you actually free, then? I need to know when I can count on you at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m free after drop-off until about 2, then again a bit after pickup if you need an extra hand. If the busiest stretch is midday, that’s the easiest window for me.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right—the repair drive. I meant to bring my toolbox, but I can still help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That works—meet me by the community center at 10, and I’ll point you to the bike station first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it—community center at 10, then the bike station first. I’ll do my best not to forget this time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it — keep me posted on how the repair drive’s coming along while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, sure — I’ll let you know how it’s going, assuming I don’t get turned around again.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Ha, fair enough — just shoot me a quick update when you get your bearings.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a running list of gloves, tape, and spare screws for the repair drive. Tell me what you still need, and I’ll check what we can cover.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Cleo — we still need a couple of hammers and a sturdy extension cord if you can check on those.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check the shed and ask around for two hammers and a sturdy extension cord. I’ll add them to my list and let you know what I can line up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a ladder and a couple drills we can lend for the repair drive if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That helps a lot, thanks. Bring them by Saturday morning and we’ll put them to use.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, I’ll bring the ladder and drills by Saturday morning. If you need a tape measure or extension cords too, I can toss those in.
